page.aiLead: Steer the bot by chatting with an AI assistant (MCP).
page.aiNote: Optional: the bot works without it. You can connect several programs at once. Connecting adds a “dbvictory-bot” entry to the chosen program's configuration, and disconnecting removes it.
page.testBuildsNote: The launcher will also offer the latest test build from GitHub (unfinished changes to try before a release). When you turn this off, you go back to the regular release at the next update.
notes.error: Could not load the change history.
notes.none: No changes are described for this release.
channel.on: Test builds on. Checking for updates…
ai.hint.codex: Restart Codex so it sees the change.
ai.hint.claude-desktop: Quit Claude Desktop completely (including from the tray) and open it again.
ai.hint.claude-code: New Claude Code sessions will see the change.
state.waitingForList: Log in to your account and leave the character list open. When you are ready, click “Connect to the game”. Do not enter a character yet.
state.startOpen: Click Start, then choose “Connect to the game” on the character list.
state.startClosed: Start opens the client. On the character list, choose “Connect to the game”.
state.engineNoConnection: The engine did not confirm the connection to the client.
state.panelNotReady: The main window did not confirm it was ready.
state.engineNotReady: The engine did not confirm it was ready.
state.running: Panel ready. You will see the login state and character readings in the main window.
state.engineReady: Engine ready. Waiting for the main window…
state.noPrompt: The preparation process did not report it was ready.
state.sessionOpenFailed: Could not open the session process.
state.newerRelease: A newer release has appeared. Check for the update again.
state.sessionFailed: The session process ended with an error.
state.waitingForWindow: Waiting for the DBVictory client window…
state.windowTimeout: The DBVictory window did not appear within a minute. You can try again after the client update.
state.channelOnlyPackage: The update channel can only be changed in an installation from a release package.
state.noClientWindow: No open client window was found. Open the client from the selected folder and click “Connect to the game” on the character list again.
state.clientRestarted: The client was restarted. Click “Connect to the game” on its character list once more.
state.folderMissingClient: This folder has no dbvStart.exe or dbvStart_gl.exe.
error.updaterFailedToRun: Could not run the local updater. Check the Python installation.
error.updaterBadReply: The updater gave an invalid reply.
error.updaterFailed: The updater ended with an error.
error.notesFormat: The release history has an invalid format.
error.notesEntry: The release history has an invalid entry.
error.windowCheck: Could not check the client window in Windows.
error.twoClients: At least two client windows from this folder are open. Keep one.
error.chooseClientFolder: Choose the folder with dbvStart.exe or dbvStart_gl.exe.
error.clientElsewhere: The client runs from another location. Choose its folder.
error.clientNotStarted: Windows did not start the DBVictory client. Check the selected folder.
error.pythonFailed: Could not start the local Python.
error.channelSave: Could not save the update channel.
error.clientFolderMissing: Choose the DBVictory client folder (with dbvStart.exe or dbvStart_gl.exe) with the “Change” button.
